What it does

Podium consolidates the customer conversations that otherwise scatter across texts, webchat and social messages into a single inbox, then layers review collection and payments on top. For trades where the first contact is a text rather than a call, that consolidation is the whole point. Pricing is contract-based, so it is worth understanding the exit terms before signing.

Where the AI actually is

AI assistants that answer and route customer conversations.

Pros

  • Consolidates texts, chats and reviews into one place
  • Strong review collection workflow
  • Customers can pay from a text

Cons

  • Contract-based pricing can be hard to exit

Who it suits

Built with Plumbers, Electricians, HVAC, Roofers in mind. Businesses where most enquiries arrive by text or webchat.
